notes.title: Golf Masters Development Update 7/23
notes.content:
Hello supporters, wanted to break the radio silence to give everyone a update on the progress of Golf Masters. We've deep in development on this title and everything is progressing well for a launch on the Vive as well and the Oculus Rift. 

We're currently in the process of upgrading the course models and menus, no small task considering that there is over 5 square kilometers of course, all accessible at a 1:1 scale in virtual reality. We have received our Vive development kit from Valve and are very excited to show everyone how room scale tracking changes the game of video game golf, literally! Now you can walk around the greens to get a good read on your lie and aim your shot. 

As our ship window is extremely short (<5 months) for a title of this scale, we want to make sure that we keep our list of features for launch reasonable, but we in addition to 18 hole 72 par championship course, we also plan to include a driving range and online leaderboard for those competitive minded individuals. 

Online multiplayer is on the roadmap as well, but honestly will most likely not be in the Vive launch edition, as it's quite a bit to add and test in such a short development cycle. Rest assured, we'll be supporting this title for some time with more content, so stay tuned!
